hook:
pick a pile.
this is what they're not saying out loud

piles.title: they're scared of ruining it
piles.text: they think about you more than they let on. the slow replies aren't distance, they're nerves. a soft message is closer than you think.

piles.title: pride is doing the talking
piles.text: they replay the last argument and still think they were right. they miss you anyway. you don't owe them the first text.

piles.title: they're already making plans
piles.text: they see a future with you and it scares them a little. they're quietly getting their life together first. watch what they do, not what they post.

cta:
comment 1, 2 or 3
and tell me if it hit
